from collections import Counter
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])

    for r in range(1, rows - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            divider = grid[r][0]
            if any(divider in row for row in grid[:r] + grid[r + 1:]):
                continue
            selected = [row[:] for row in grid[r + 1:]]
            other = [row for row in grid[:r]]
            return recolor(selected, other)

    for c in range(1, cols - 1):
        divider = grid[0][c]
        if all(row[c] == divider for row in grid):
            if any(row[j] == divider for row in grid for j in range(cols) if j != c):
                continue
            selected = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            other = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            return recolor(selected, other)

    return [row[:] for row in grid]


def recolor(selected, other):
    selected_values = [v for row in selected for v in row]
    other_values = [v for row in other for v in row]
    dominant = Counter(selected_values).most_common(1)[0][0]
    other_dominant = Counter(other_values).most_common(1)[0][0]
    background = dominant if dominant in set(other_values) else other_dominant
    return [[background if v == dominant else 3 for v in row] for row in selected]
'''
